permittedTransformations.rule: React hook bodies from renderHook callbacks live in tests/_fixtures/hooks.tsrx exports mounted by name

result.current / result.current[0] / toEqual object receivers may become DOM textContent string forms of the same observable value; expect() receivers are compared (signal calls and literals must not weaken); matcher contracts (toBe/toEqual/toHaveBeenCalledTimes/toBeDefined/toBeGreaterThan) must still cover every pristine assertion value
act(...) may become await nextPaint() around the same state transition; concurrent Promise.all microtask setters stay microtask-concurrent
Every adapted case requires // Per src/index.test.ts:<line> citing the pristine it() line for that title
Adapted result.find/click #ids must exist in hooks.tsrx; file sha256 alone cannot silence semantic id removal

Each pristine hook-surface setter write (result.current / destructured setter alias inside act) must remain a hook-path transition in the adapted case: authenticated setter invocations inside a mountResult.click('#id') handler whose mounted fixture's #id onClick invokes a useSignal/useSetSignal setter on an always-executed handler statement (parsed from the fixture AST; dead branches, nested unused functions, and handlers that also call props.source(...) do not authenticate; count and normalized update shapes must match the pristine writes), or a SetterProbe-style recorded setter call bound from setters.at / setters[i] on an array that received .push of the record-callback parameter from a fixture whose active props.record(<useSignal setter>) call is parsed from the fixture AST (comments/decoys do not qualify). Incidental callees, stub-array aliases without push, clicks whose handlers call props.source directly, dead-code padding of setter shapes, and collapsing multiple queued functional updates into fewer setter invocations do not count. Replacing hook-path coverage with direct createSignal source writes is rejected even when assertion contracts and global fixture ids still match.

notes: Title identity remains one-for-one. This ledger is enforced by scripts/react-parity/alien-signals-runtime-lib.mjs, which compares normalized assertion contracts (including expect receivers), Per citations, per-case hook-surface→authenticated-fixture-click/recorded-setter transitions, referenced fixture ids, and fixture-export fingerprints rather than titles alone.
